svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: AKS application platform on Azure
svg.desc: AKS application platform on Azure. 8 components in 8 groups. Connections: Users to Application Gateway (HTTPS); Application Gateway to User nodes; User nodes to Container Registry (pull images); User nodes to Managed identity (federated token); Managed identity to Key Vault (read secrets); System nodes to Log Analytics; User nodes to Log Analytics.

text.tspan: Application Gateway in front of an AKS cluster that pulls from Container Registry, reads Key Vault through workload identity and logs to Log Analytics
